summary: Ten comment-endorsed tools, apps, books, visual archives, and media picks from 30 fully crawled HN threads.
telegram_footer: 10 items surfaced | 30/30 current front-page stories processed | history + run artifact updated.

items.name: Bitwig Studio
items.summary: A Linux-native digital audio workstation with modular synthesis and flexible PipeWire routing.
items.why_included: A license owner praised its Linux support, routing, bundled plugins, and modular Grid.
items.evidence: The commenter does not regret buying Bitwig despite its price and noted strong Linux audio features.

evidence_sources.author: bigyabai
evidence_sources.excerpt: Bitwig natively supports Linux. I bought a license a while ago and while the cost is steep, I don't regret it at all.

items.name: Droid-ify
items.source_story_title: AnkiDroid: Google Play no longer allowing Open Collective donation link
items.summary: A modern Android client for browsing and installing apps from F-Droid repositories.
items.why_included: A regular user reported that the client rarely gives them trouble.
items.evidence: The commenter uses Droid-ify and reported few issues.

evidence_sources.author: nisiddharth
evidence_sources.excerpt: I use the Droid-ify client and rarely get issues

items.name: Redlib
items.source_story_title: AnkiDroid: Google Play no longer allowing Open Collective donation link
items.summary: A private, self-hostable alternative web front end for browsing Reddit.
items.why_included: A commenter named Redlib as the privacy-friendly alternative they actively use.
items.evidence: The commenter said they use Redlib instead of the service discussed upstream.

evidence_sources.author: kelvinjps10
evidence_sources.excerpt: I use redlib https://github.com/redlib-org/redlib and librediret instead.

items.name: Plexamp
items.summary: A dedicated Plex music player for curated, self-hosted personal libraries.
items.why_included: A self-hosting listener called it a genuinely good alternative to frustrating streaming apps.
items.evidence: The commenter uses Plexamp for albums and praised it despite proprietary-code limitations.

evidence_sources.author: yard2010
evidence_sources.excerpt: Plexamp is not perfect and not open source unfortunately, but it's a really good non-enshitified product.

items.name: The Joy of X
items.source_story_title: Terence Tao explains 6 essential mathematical concepts [video]
items.summary: Steven Strogatz's accessible tour of mathematical ideas from arithmetic to infinity.
items.why_included: A commenter directly recommended it as a great companion read to Tao's video.
items.evidence: The commenter called The Joy of X a great related read.

evidence_sources.author: thedreammachine
evidence_sources.excerpt: Related and a great read: "The Joy of X: A Guided Tour of Math, from One to Infinity" by Steven Strogatz

items.name: Qwen Fixed Chat Templates
items.source_story_title: Show HN: Running 104GB Qwen3.8-Flash-Next on 48GB Mac with at ~12 tok/s
items.summary: Community Jinja chat templates tuned for running Qwen models with vLLM.
items.why_included: A production user reported good agentic results and emphatically recommended the templates.
items.evidence: The commenter runs the templates with vLLM and urged readers not to overlook them.

evidence_sources.author: hadlock
evidence_sources.excerpt: Don't sleep on the froggeric templates.

items.name: Jujutsu
items.source_story_title: The creator of Jujutsu has joined ERSC
items.summary: A Git-compatible version-control system built around a different local workflow model.
items.why_included: A regular user preferred its model to Git and found the learning investment worthwhile.
items.evidence: The commenter prefers Jujutsu's model and said its workflow benefits justified the learning curve.

evidence_sources.author: sbuttgereit
evidence_sources.excerpt: Personally, and as a mere version control user, I prefer the JJ model of version control much more than Git's.

items.name: Movie Scene Map
items.source_story_title: Movie Scene Map – 13,312 films, series, games, anime and manga
items.summary: An interactive map of filming and story locations across screen media and games.
items.why_included: A user discovered nearby filming locations and praised the map's design and interaction.
items.evidence: The commenter found previously unknown local filming locations and praised the experience.

evidence_sources.author: radiorental
evidence_sources.excerpt: Nice work, nice design, slick UX and Interaction model. Well done!

items.name: Pavement Paradise
items.summary: A Center for Land Use Interpretation archive documenting American parking spaces.
items.why_included: A commenter singled it out as a personal favorite within CLUI's excellent work.
items.evidence: The commenter identified Pavement Paradise as one of their favorite CLUI projects.

evidence_sources.author: henryrobbins00
evidence_sources.excerpt: One of my personal favorites is Pavement Paradise [2] documenting American parking spaces.

items.name: tmp.0ut 2026 Mixtape
items.summary: An experimental mixtape released alongside the fifth tmp.0ut hacker zine.
items.why_included: A listener called the genre-ambiguous mix both great and very interesting.
items.evidence: The commenter praised the mixtape and found its sound difficult to categorize but compelling.

evidence_sources.author: NDlurker
evidence_sources.excerpt: The mixtape is great. Not sure what genre this would be considered but it's very interesting
